spanish: Y no se acercarán todavía hijos de Israel a tienda de reunión, a alzar pecado a morir.

findings.issue: לא before the verb and עוֹד after it license “not again / no longer.” “no se acercarán todavía” reads as “not yet.”

notes: Remaining tokens match: approach, sons of Israel, to tent of meeting, to lift sin, to die.
